# Support

## Questions

For general questions, "how do I…?", "is this expected?", or to share ideas, please use [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/rakeshnitb23/toolism/discussions).

## Bugs

If you have found a bug, please use the [Bug report form](https://github.com/rakeshnitb23/toolism/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).

## Security

For security vulnerabilities, please refer to our [Security Policy](https://github.com/rakeshnitb23/toolism/blob/main/SECURITY.md) and use the private advisory link.

## Contributing

If you want to contribute to the project, please read our [Contributing Guidelines](https://github.com/rakeshnitb23/toolism/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
